lines.en: Good morning! Let's walk by the river today.
Yes, Grandma. Is the river deep here?
Here it is deep, so stay near me.
Look, the water flows so fast!
Yesterday, after the rain, it flowed even faster.
lines.ko: 어제 비 온 뒤에는 더 빨리 흘렀어요.

lines.en: Can we cross that old bridge?
Sure. From the bridge we can see the island.
Look, a boat! Can we ride it, Grandma?
Not today. Next summer we will ride a boat.
lines.ko: 오늘은 안 돼요. 내년 여름에 배를 탈 거예요.

lines.en: Great! Thank you for the walk, Grandma.
Hello. Can two people ride this boat?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 두 사람이 이 배를 탈 수 있어요?

lines.en: Yes, welcome. Please sit right here.
lines.ko: 네, 어서 오세요. 바로 여기 앉으세요.

lines.en: Thank you. The lake is so calm and great.
Yes. Last week a storm made big waves here.
lines.ko: 네. 지난주에는 폭풍으로 여기 파도가 컸어요.

lines.en: Where does the water come from?
A small stream flows into the lake from the mountain.
Is that an island over there?
Yes. We will go around the island.
lines.ko: 네. 섬을 한 바퀴 돌 거예요.

lines.en: Great. Can we stop at the shore later?
lines.ko: 멋져요. 나중에 물가에 잠깐 설 수 있어요?

lines.en: Sure. We will stop there for ten minutes.
lines.ko: 그럼요. 거기서 십 분 동안 멈출 거예요.
